article: Display a Windows MessageBox using Rust and windows-sys
scope: Compared the complete Japanese source with all twelve translations, duplicate metadata, steps, crate/version/feature selection, Rust code, UTF-16 handling, unsafe FFI boundary, images, and internal/external links.
findings: Removed duplicate date keys while preserving the original 2022 publication date and recording the review as lastmod.
Replaced the obsolete winapi and user32-sys 0.2 dependencies with windows-sys 0.61 and its WindowsAndMessaging feature.
Changed the ANSI MessageBoxA/CString example to MessageBoxW with explicitly NUL-terminated UTF-16 strings.
Aligned Cargo project and directory names, normalized the Rust code fence, and replaced the stale reference with current primary documentation.
Ran cargo check successfully in a temporary Windows Cargo project against windows-sys 0.61.2; the GUI was not launched.

post/RustでMessageBoxを表示する/index.en.md.summary: Compared the complete translation with the Japanese source and updated its Cargo setup, Windows API example, UTF-16 handling, metadata, and documentation links.

meaning.note: Compared the complete step sequence and clarified that this is a Windows-only example.

terminology.note: Updated winapi/user32-sys references to Microsoft windows-sys and explained UTF-16 and FFI terminology.

mathematics.note: The article contains no mathematical claims or formulas.

code.note: Compiled the extracted Rust example with cargo check on Windows; windows-sys 0.61.2 resolved and the check passed. The GUI was not launched. Static review covered UTF-16 NUL termination, the feature flag, and the unsafe FFI call.

links.note: Replaced the stale external example with windows-sys API/crate documentation, Microsoft MessageBoxW documentation, and the Microsoft windows-rs repository; checked localized internal links.

limitations: AI-assisted review by Codex; no human or native-speaker certification.
The Rust snippet passed cargo check on Windows but the MessageBox was not launched, so this does not confirm its visual behavior on all Windows versions.
The code is a minimal Windows-only demonstration; it does not handle the MessageBoxW return value.
Crate versions and generated API signatures may change; consult current windows-sys documentation.
